request: 把全量 Go 测试超时的问题也查清楚并解决，跑完验证，保留现有数据，Aide 还是不要 release。
acceptance: Explain both prior timeout stacks and measure actual setup cost.
Reduce repeated executable hashing allocation without caching hashes or skipping integrity checks.
Complete every registered Go test/fuzz seed/example plus other packages, race and vet with pass/skip evidence.
Run isolated without production data mounts; verify current data and running service unchanged.
Document and merge the fix without Aide version/tag/Release.
Actually complete both verify full and aide.sh test; preserve errors and avoid legacy shared mounts/15m limit.
scope: Integrity executable hashing and meaningful regression tests
Full-suite test evidence and developer documentation
Unify the legacy aide.sh test entry with the existing isolated Go snapshot runner

requirements.summary: User requests root cause, fix and complete Go validation while preserving data and prohibiting Aide Release.

design.summary: Stream the executable into SHA-256 on every check to bound allocation; no digest cache, test bypass or deadline-only workaround. Measure before/after profiles and run complete inventory.

implementation.summary: Fresh streamed executable SHA-256 and content mutation/read-failure regressions; legacy aide.sh test delegates to existing isolated runner with exit-code/settings tests.

verification.summary: Final fingerprint-bound full and actual aide.sh test both exit 0; each processes all 1768 registered server items (1677 pass, 91 explicit skips, zero missing/fail), remaining race packages, platform contracts and vet. Quick 343 and targeted launcher/router tests pass.

documentation.summary: Current verification docs and root-cause/results updated; links checked.

cleanup.summary: Owned test containers removed; profiles and receipts retained locally. Production unchanged except independently observed plugin operations, which were preserved; 205 protected files and all session records verified.

release.summary: Explicitly prohibited by user: no Aide version/tag/Release or deployment.

release_authorization: Aide version/tag/Release prohibited. Isolated implementation and validation authorized.
rollback: No production mutations. Git changes limited to hashing/tests/developer entry/docs; no migration or runtime data change.
handoff: Go suite root cause resolved, both complete test entry points passed, main merge pending final CI. Runtime remains original service/image.
